About the Practice

Montefiore Medical Center is a premier academic health system and the primary teaching hospital of the Albert Einstein College of Medicine in the Bronx, New York City. It is nationally recognized for its clinical excellence and provides a wide range of medical specialties and services across 10 hospitals and numerous outpatient sites. Montefiore is committed to providing comprehensive, coordinated care, including specialized services through notable Centers of Excellence like the Montefiore Einstein Center for Cancer Care, Montefiore Einstein Center for Heart and Vascular Care, and Montefiore Einstein Center for Transplantation. [6, 8, 12, 14]

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Montefiore Medical Center utilizes Montefiore MyChart as its patient portal. MyChart is a patient portal system provided by Epic Systems Corporation. Therefore, Montefiore Medical Center is using Epic as its Electronic Health Record (EHR) vendor.
